scope: H200 SM90, ten-block checkpoint input replay surrogate, 16 users in two sequential passes, 64K+128, P32768/NH1050624, 4GiB HBM/64GiB DRAM.
method: Read accepted metadata/independent_audit JSON and small measurements JSONL; derive arithmetic totals and linear-interpolated p95. No hashing, GPU execution, raw tensor/trace audit, or report generation.
shared_geometry: fixed_c2048 is the same physical C2048/W2048 observation used as the deployment control; not an independent duplicate sample.

initial_assessments.trace_variability: Only the initial trace per physical configuration is available. ECHO deployment totals are C256 227801.668596 ms, C1024 78436.862621 ms, and C2048 129513.492560 ms. C2048 reuses the single fixed_c2048 observation. Do not select a final default until the declared C1024/C2048 deployment repeats are accepted; within-trace request dispersion is not independent between-run variation.
initial_assessments.cold_prefix_and_revisit: At W=C, C1024 is 39.4373% lower in full ECHO trace time than C2048, but first-visit mean is 4827.457615 vs 4002.318200 ms and all-request p95 is 4833.571265 vs 4116.702712 ms. Its revisit mean is 74.846299 vs 4092.275085 ms because the former has 16/16 prefix hits and the latter has 16/16 rebuilds. C256 also has 16 hits and slightly lower hit latency, but cold construction makes its full trace 2.9043 times C1024. The predeclared trace mixes sixteen first visits and sixteen revisits; do not invent another mixture to erase the cold/tail tradeoff.
initial_assessments.workspace_and_capacity: Fixed W2048 keeps ECHO capacity at 15 sessions for all C and all sixteen revisits rebuild; larger C lowers complete cold execution cost. Deployment C1024/W1024 reserves 1709604446 shared HBM bytes, versus 2922020446 at C2048/W2048, with unchanged 86682744 HBM and 4104 DRAM bytes per session. The smaller workspace permits all sixteen users instead of fifteen under the same 4GiB cap and fixed NH/P. C256/W256 reserves still less workspace but preserves no additional user in this 16-user trace. The result is a session capacity threshold, not measured token-cache hits or an offload kernel overlap result.
initial_assessments.scope_and_limitations: H200 SM90, checkpoint workload surrogate with ten independent source-input replay dense blocks, 64K+128, 16 users in two serial passes, fixed P32768/NH1050624 and 4GiB HBM/64GiB DRAM. Initial C1024 ECHO trace is 14.7538% lower than same-C HBM, while ECHO is 14.8957% slower than same-C serial_sparse. No ECHO fusion speedup is established. All-request p95 and cold request costs matter separately from the full-trace objective. Cache reservations/observed boundary bytes are not process peaks; session prefix hits do not quantify HBM token hits. No general optimal C, real workload quality, concurrency or throughput conclusion.

recommendation.target: ECHO deployment prefill configuration for the predeclared complete trace
recommendation.decision_authority: Independent recommendation only; root owns the official default_review and default configuration.
recommendation.reason: The complete-trace objective favors C1024 because it retains all sixteen sessions and avoids all second-pass rebuilds. C2048 lowers cold construction cost but its larger workspace admits only fifteen sessions, so this cyclic access pattern rebuilds every revisit. Both repeats reproduce that mechanism and ordering.
recommendation.scope: H200 SM90; ten independent checkpoint source-input replay dense blocks; fixed 65536-token history and 128-token candidate; sixteen users visited sequentially twice; P32768 per layer, NH1050624, 4GiB HBM and 64GiB CPU DRAM cache budgets; complete hidden and last-token head; recorded runtime source 47585a615f0bb017f531118e8c8c180cb33cb14d63de447cd83c84966210a211.

further_repetitions.reason: The slowest accepted C1024 trace is still 49.911820 s faster than the fastest C2048 trace (38.8877% lower). The within-configuration trace spans are 1.455298 s and 1.164810 s, respectively; capacities and sixteen hit/rebuild outcomes are unchanged. There is no unresolved ordering or variation that justifies another trace for this decision. C256 is not the leader and its accepted initial total is 227.801669 s, so no new repeat or diagnostic point is requested.
further_repetitions.statistical_limit: Two complete traces per C1024/C2048 configuration provide a descriptive observed range, not a confidence interval, significance test or bound on future variance. Per-request samples within a trace are not independent trace repetitions.

final_assessments.trace_variability: C1024 ECHO totals are 76.981564–78.436863 s; C2048 totals are 128.348683–129.513493 s. Their spans divided by their respective two-run means are 1.8727% and 0.9034%. Mean complete trace time is 39.7281% lower at C1024. The initial fixed_c2048 run supplies the C2048 deployment observation once; it is not counted again as a separate repeat.
final_assessments.cold_prefix_and_revisit: C1024 first-visit means are 4738.079581–4827.457615 ms versus C2048 3970.365545–4002.318200 ms; actual cold-prefix means are 4666.692801–4754.377805 versus 3936.256263–3970.326478 ms. C1024 revisit means are 73.268199–74.846299 ms, sixteen hits in each trace; C2048 is 4051.427142–4092.275085 ms, sixteen rebuilds in each. All-request per-trace p95 is 4744.087128–4833.571265 ms at C1024 versus 4059.999656–4116.702712 at C2048. Recommend C1024 for the declared sixteen-first/sixteen-revisit trace objective while preserving its colder-request and overall-tail disadvantage; do not reweight the request mix or call the mean of per-trace p95 values a pooled p95.
final_assessments.workspace_and_capacity: At fixed W2048, every tested ECHO C admits fifteen sessions and rebuilds all sixteen revisits; C2048 is the fastest initial complete trace within that controlled-workspace comparison. The deployment choice separately reduces W to C. C1024 shared HBM reservation is 1709604446 bytes versus 2922020446 at C2048, with the same 86682744 HBM/4104 DRAM bytes per session, P32768 and NH1050624. Sixteen sessions at C1024 reserve 3096528350 HBM bytes; fifteen at C2048 reserve 4222261606. C256 uses less workspace but cannot retain more than the sixteen users actually present and is much slower to build. Accepted C1024/C2048 memory gates and matching diagnostics support the selected/control geometries; this independent read does not rerun those audits or broaden their coverage.
final_assessments.scope_and_limitations: The selected C1024 ECHO mean trace is 15.4995% lower than same-C HBM, but 15.0766% slower than same-C serial_sparse, whose trace range is 66.788647–68.267879 s. Thus the recommendation does not establish a fused-prefetch speed advantage or select ECHO as the fastest scheme. It is a session-capacity tradeoff in this fixed cyclic trace, not evidence of HBM token hit rate, kernel overlap, general cache optimality, model quality, concurrent throughput or a trained ten-block model. Cache-owned reservations and request-boundary samples do not equal process peaks. C512 remains numerically excluded and C4096 budget-excluded; neither enters rankings. The original initial_assessments are retained as historical pre-repeat reasoning, not the final decision basis.

memory_and_diagnostic_basis.boundary: Previously accepted engineering prerequisites, including original observer source identities and coverage. No hashing or raw allocation/diagnostic re-audit is performed by this recommendation.
